description: Use this when someone wants to find or compare registered migration agencies in Australia by city, suburb, state, agency name, agent name or MARN. Returns 10 agencies per page with Google rating, review count, number of registered agents, phone, website and a profile URL. Default order is the website’s relevance ranking, which includes paid featured placement; featured agencies are marked featured_placement, so say so when presenting them. Do not use for visa advice or eligibility.

location.description: Australian city or suburb, e.g. Melbourne, Parramatta or Box Hill. Matches the agency’s listed office, not a distance radius.

min_rating.description: Only agencies with a Google rating at or above this value.

name.description: Agency name, registered agent name, or a 7-digit MARN.

page.description: Page of 10 results. Use next_page from the previous response.

sort.description: Same orders as the website. relevance is its published ranking (rating, reviews, roster, claimed profile and paid featured placement); rating is highest Google rating; agents is most registered agents.

state.description: Australian state or territory: NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT or NT. Use it with location to disambiguate, or alone for a whole state.

name: search_migration_agencies
title: Search migration agencies
